body:
GRAMMAR.md §1 adds SEMI as a 4th token shape; §2's Program rule becomes TypedExpr SEMI. Lexer/parser both updated -- a missing trailing ; is now a real, explicit parse error, not silently accepted. §7's 3 pre-existing worked examples annotated (they predate this, each now needs a trailing ; to parse). 4 parser tests, 2 emitter tests updated. Verified live via the CLI. go build/vet/test clean. LO commit f93cdd0.

⚓ ☃
title: Require a trailing semicolon to terminate every LO program
